entries.title: Your first mate saves a standing direction you chose on a card
entries.body: When you choose a rule on a card, or say it while your first mate is working, your first mate can save it as a standing direction without you typing it again. Each change to a direction now shows in Activity like any setting, and its history keeps the reason your first mate gave. Your first mate can also sign you out of a GitLab or GitHub Enterprise host when you ask, as Settings can.
entries.noPicture: This changes when the first mate may save a direction; the Directions list looks as it did.
